description: Adds properties to a Ready, Active or Paused campaign and spends wallet dollars. Each added property starts at step 1 on its own schedule; properties already in the campaign are untouched. Before calling this, call dealmachine_mail_read with operation add_properties_estimate and the property count, tell the user the charge due today (pay_today_cents) and the amount charged later as mail goes out (pay_later_cents), and get their approval. A paused campaign charges nothing today; each piece is charged as it goes out after it resumes (charged_on_resume). Auto-reload must be on when the campaign has more than one step, a repeating step, or any delay. The response lists added_count and each skipped property with its reason: already_in_campaign, do_not_contact, no_mailing_address, duplicate_mailing_address, archived_prospect or not_found. Find campaigns that accept properties with dealmachine_mail_read search_campaigns and accepting_properties=true.

confirmed.description: Set to true only after the user approves the charge due today from the estimate

recipient.description: owner mails the owner's mailing address; resident mails the current resident at the property
